note: Which family names have a page, and nothing else. A family page is drawn by src/lib/families.js from the archive's own people.json, kin.js households, pedigree.json, places.json and register.json: no sentence on it is typed here. Written 17 October 2026. `fold` is the namefold.json target(s) whose spellings belong to the family (folding is a search rule; this page only groups what the fold already groups); `line` is the people.json `l` label when the archive keeps that family as one of its eleven lines; `register` names the register.json groups filed under the name; `page` is the address of a hand-built page that already exists (Barry and Kolbe), otherwise the page is /families/<slug>/. Core rule, stated on /families/: a name is core if a direct-line ancestor on pedigree.json carries it, or it has at least eight people on these pages, or the archive's own research files treat it as a family under investigation; the twelve most important missing ones were made, direct-line first, then by number of people.
